summary: Victim accessed a phishing website impersonating Ledger Live and entered a 24 word recovery phrase. The attacker used the recovery phrase to gain control of the wallet and transfer BabyDoge DOGE and SUI assets valued at approximately 2314 USD.
user_mistake: Entered a wallet recovery phrase into a fraudulent website impersonating a wallet provider
prevention: Never enter recovery phrases into websites / Access wallet software only through verified official sources
